name: Defending Our Faith
overview: Scripture calls believers to steadfastly uphold and defend their faith even amid opposition and false accusations, as Jesus teaches that those persecuted for His sake are blessed (Matthew 5:11). The early church exemplified this by engaging thoughtfully with others, such as Paul’s ministry in Thessalonica and his exhortation to walk wisely and redeem the time among outsiders (Acts 17:1; Colossians 4:5). Sound doctrine is essential for effectively encouraging and refuting opponents, as Titus emphasizes the need to hold firmly to the faithful word in order to convince gainsayers (Titus 1:9). This defense of the faith is to be conducted with sincerity and love within the fellowship of believers, reflecting the unity and care expressed in the churches’ greetings (Romans 16:16; Philippians 1:16).
